title: DAILY FIGHTER — FOUNDATION WEEK 3 DAY 16
emphasis: Friday HARD: shoulder-conservative front-lever bodyline, weighted horizontal strength, barbell hinge, kettlebell power, active mobility and loaded carry. Current shoulder status is unknown; every movement stays pain-free.

levels.bonus: Optional 5:00 easy walk. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/E×1 (19:25), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Curved-Treadmill Intervals
ignition.cue: RPE 5; build heat without fatigue; shoulders relaxed

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: FRONT-LEVER BODYLINE FOUNDATION
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 4–5, ≥5 RIR. NONE VERIFIED; low-fatigue repeat only, no lever-gate credit. Next gate: tuck lever 3×15–20 sec on two user-confirmed exposures ≤RPE 8.

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Hollow Hold
exercises.cue: Arms by sides; low back down; bodyline adjunct only

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: SUPPORTED PULL + SPLIT-STANCE PRESS
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 6, 4 RIR. NONE VERIFIED; establish pain-free load/ROM baselines. Next gate: two clean user-confirmed 3×6–8 exposures at 2–3 RIR before load changes.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.cue: Neutral grip; chest supported; stop for symptoms

exercises.name: Split-Stance One-Arm Cable Press
exercises.cue: LEFT → SWITCH → RIGHT; ribs stacked; symptom-free arc

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: BARBELL HINGE + LATERAL TRUNK
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RDL RPE 7/3 RIR; plank RPE 6/≥4 RIR. NONE VERIFIED; record load and ROM. Gates: two user-confirmed clean 3×8 RDL and 3×25-sec/side plank exposures.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Hips back; lats tight; record actual load

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.cue: LEFT → SWITCH → RIGHT; shoulder stacked; pain-free support only

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: KETTLEBELL HIP POWER
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 6, ≥4 RIR. NONE VERIFIED; establish a light power baseline and stop when speed, catch, posture, or comfort declines.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Clean
exercises.cue: LEFT → SWITCH → RIGHT; quiet catch; stop for shoulder discomfort

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: ACTIVE ANKLE MOBILITY + SUITCASE CARRY
deposits.effort: Rest 0:20; 6:20 total. Mobility RPE 4; carry RPE 7/3 RIR. NONE VERIFIED; establish pain-free ROM, load and posture baselines before progression.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
exercises.cue: LEFT → SWITCH → RIGHT; heel down; smooth active range

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: LEFT → SWITCH → RIGHT; tall posture; quiet steps; no lean

martialSupplement.name: Hip Escape
martialSupplement.cue: Separate optional BJJ practice; shoulders relaxed; never auto-log
